title: Dispute Windows, Provisional Credit and Liability Caps on the Northbeam Credit Products
content:
A charge on an account of the Northbeam Store Credit and Financing Accounts range may be disputed for a stated number of days after the statement closes. Each product sets that number, sets whether the disputed amount is credited while the dispute is looked into, and sets the most the customer may be held to for unauthorised use.

| Product | Days after a statement closes within which a charge may be disputed | Disputed amount credited while the dispute is looked into | Most the customer may be held to for unauthorised use |
|---|---|---|---|
| Northbeam Store Card | 60 | yes | 50.00 |
| Northbeam Store Card Plus | 60 | yes | 0.00 |
| Northbeam Signature Rewards Card | 90 | yes | 0.00 |
| Northbeam Deferred Interest Promotion Account | 60 | yes | 50.00 |
| Northbeam Business Net Thirty Account | 60 | no | 250.00 |
| Northbeam Business Fleet Line of Credit | 90 | no | 500.00 |

Cap figures are US dollars.

## Both sides of the window

The window is a number of days after the statement closes. On a product whose window is 60 days, the sixtieth day after the statement closed is still inside the window and the sixty-first is outside it; on a product whose window is 90 days, the ninetieth day is inside and the ninety-first outside. Two products in the range, the Northbeam Signature Rewards Card and the Northbeam Business Fleet Line of Credit, carry the longer 90-day window; the other four carry 60.

## The two other columns

Provisional credit while the dispute is looked into is given on the four consumer products and not on the two business products.

The liability cap for unauthorised use is 0.00 on the Northbeam Store Card Plus and the Northbeam Signature Rewards Card, 50.00 on the Northbeam Store Card and the Northbeam Deferred Interest Promotion Account, 250.00 on the Northbeam Business Net Thirty Account and 500.00 on the Northbeam Business Fleet Line of Credit.
